sloka: एतावदुक्त्वा वचनं गन्धर्वा: समहर्षय: ।राजर्षयश्चैव तदा सर्वे स्वांस्वां गतिं गता: ॥ २.११२.७॥
transliteration: etāvaduktvā vacanaṁ gandharvā: samaharṣaya: ।rājarṣayaścaiva tadā sarve svāṁsvāṁ gatiṁ gatā: ॥ 2.112.7॥

translations.english: Then the great rishis, gandharvas and royal sages having said this, returned to their respective abodes.
